fusions.name: Cracked Throw
fusions.desc: A hatchet thrown with a crack that deals 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at the maximum range of 7 tiles, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Powder Burst
fusions.desc: Fires a hatchet that deals 36 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every other enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Loaded Edge
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 40% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Crack Back
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a report cracks out to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
